name: Correction Training lets diffusion models beat CFG without guidance
title: Correction Training lets diffusion models beat CFG without guidance
summary: A separate corrector model refines the denoiser's predictions at each sampling step, improving ImageNet-256 quality by about 80% for DiT and SiT without classifier-free guidance at similar cost, and lifting GenEval from 28.3% to 50.1% without CFG.
